newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Airlines confirms in coop talks.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Airlines confirms in coop talks.

text.p: Austrian Airlines confirmed on Tuesday it was in cooperation talks with Singapore Airlines and said it hoped to strike a deal before the start of the winter timetable at the end of October.
"I can confirm that we are in talks but nothing has been signed," an Austrian Airlines spokesman told Reuters. "We hope to have something concrete by the end of October."
He declined to comment on the content of the talks. Vienna daily Die Presse reported on Tuesday that the pact would include a code sharing deal on the Vienna-Singapore route.
The spokesman said the Austrian carrier had earlier conducted parallel talks with Malaysian Airlines but had made more progress with Singapore Airlines.
Singapore Airlines already operates an alliance with Delta Airlines of the United States and Swissair, which has a 10 percent stake in Austrian Airlines.
Austrian Airlines has a cooperation deal with Delta, Swissair and Belgium's Sabena. -- Janet McBride, Vienna Newsroom 43-1-531 12 254
